StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

ShouldFlush.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: turn_structure G4 is fixed at the site this entry is the trigger surface for. combat.py:806 now calls `self.player.discard_hand(flush=self.hooks.should_flush_hand())` instead of guarding the whole call, and `discard_hand` (player.py:223-240) treats flush=False as 'every card is retained' -- it skips the move and still runs the tail, `hooks.on_hand_emptied(self)` at :240 -- which is FlushPlayerHand's false-arm (CombatManager.cs:1327-1346). VERIFIED 2026-07-27 by reading combat.py and player.py. Residual explicitly NOT part of this entry and still open at turn_structure G4: the sim has no `after_flush` dispatch at all (executed grep: zero hits in sts2_rl/).

AfterSideTurnEnd.issue: NARROWED 2026-07-27, and the reason it stands has changed. THE ROOT CAUSE NAMED HERE IS FIXED: `should_take_extra_turn` moved to combat.py:1293, AFTER `on_player_turn_end`, `_process_turn_end_cards`, the flush and `after_player_turn_end` (:1252-1275) -- turn_structure G3, mirroring SwitchFromPlayerToEnemySide (CombatManager.cs:1360-1373). But this power still ticks from `on_enemy_side_end` (powers.py:4082-4083), and an extra turn still skips that, because combat.py:1292-1307 returns (via `_start_player_turn`) before ever reaching `_execute_enemy_turn` (:1309), and `on_enemy_side_end` is dispatched only from inside `_execute_enemy_turn` (combat.py:617). So the executed witness stands -- one end_turn with a should_take_extra_turn listener leaves Retain Hand(1) on the player where C# has already decremented at :1307. LIVE, RE-EXECUTED 2026-07-30 with a NAMED trigger: Pael's Eye (`relics/paels_eye.py`, ANCIENT relic, ported) grants an extra player turn (`should_take_extra_turn`, :55-59) whenever the player ends their turn having played no cards, once per combat; Retain Hand is granted by Equilibrium (`cards/colorless_skills.py:259-280`) or Salvo (`cards/colorless_attacks.py:405-428`), both ported colorless cards, `PowerCmd.apply(..., RetainHandPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. Playing either card, holding Pael's Eye, and ending the turn without playing another card reaches the exact skipped-tick path: the extra turn is granted, `on_enemy_side_end` never fires this round, and Retain Hand's counter is not decremented where C# has already decremented it. FIX: move the tick to a slot that runs before the `should_take_extra_turn` check but after the flush -- `after_player_turn_end` (combat.py:1275) is exactly that slot, confirming this entry's earlier reasoning that it would NOT fix it is FALSE.

guards.rationale: The sim's on_enemy_side_end takes no argument and the power does not filter (powers.py:3542-3543) -- it does not need to, since the slot is reached once per round and this power is player-only in ported content (Equilibrium / Salvo). Note that the shifted slot means the filter C# needs is exactly the filter the sim cannot express there.

The sim's Power._tick (powers.py:70-75) decrements the field and _expires at <= 0 where C# routes through PowerCmd.Decrement -> ModifyAmount -> ShouldRemoveDueToAmount (PowerCmd.cs:215-250) -- Decrement, not TickDownDuration, so neither side honours SkipNextDurationTick. Observationally identical for a Buff: ModifyAmount's only unconditional modifier leg is Hook.ModifyPowerAmountReceived (PowerCmd.cs:234), whose ported listeners are ArtifactPower (Debuff-only) and RuinedHelmet (StrengthPower-only). Same mechanism and same verdict as audit/records/power/colossus.json's AfterSideTurnEnd guard, per binding rule 3.

guards.what: Interaction with the per-card Retain keyword
guards.rationale: The sim's discard_hand keeps cards with card.retain (player.py:192-196) independently of this power, which is C#'s per-card ShouldRetainThisTurn path. Two independent mechanisms on both sides; this power's false ShouldFlush short-circuits the whole flush, so the per-card path is moot when it is active.
